memory_measurement: macOS ps RSS after each retained revision and /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size; no Linux cgroup
data_source: synthetic deterministic records; no chain or network
workload: isolated full-size single domain; 12 sequential queries per cap; separate 2-query + six-version retention per cap
measurements: JSONL elapsed phase times, ps RSS after each retained revision, /usr/bin/time -l maximum RSS
limits: not an 8 GiB Linux cgroup; no concurrency, service, replicas, placement, or QPS measurement
